notes.title: Major Update [ Hackshot v1.93 ] drops with a 50% discount
notes.content:
Hackshot is featured at the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase, with a huge discount as well

Let's just get into what's new:

[h2]=> Master Hacker Conquests[/h2]
These new challenges require using some interesting and obscure interactions in the game, they are also a new way to gain stars in the game, which grants a new alternative for a smoother progression.

There will be 100+ Conquest stars in this update

[previewyoutube=ZDA4Lr1Fx8w;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]=> Critical nodes can now grant more stars[/h2]
Critical nodes such as 11, 22, 33, ... are usually much more involved than normal nodes (levels), so now they can grant more stars than usual. I think this helps to match their involvement with an appropriate reward.

The ones with the least stars can now grant up to 7 stars, and the highest one is much higher than that.

[h2]=> New Story Chapter[/h2]
No spoilers 😏

[h2]=> Steam Achievements and Cloud save[/h2]
Finally !!!
And as of now, the game will have 80 achievements on Steam, maybe at May 29th a couple more will be added as well

[h2]=> Simplified Chinese In-game Guide[/h2]
By the generous effort of @OldCaptainWZJ, I have managed to add an in-game guide in Simplified Chinese

[h2]=> A ton of User Interface and Quality of Life improvements[/h2]
I will just list some to make the point:
[list]
[*] Slimmer and easier to use shot tools panel,
[*] New score lists: Highlights your current scores easily, as well as highlighting Ascended hacks, Exploits and Maxed nodes,
[*] Some new icons for the Mod Wheel for better readability,
[*] Faster simulation speed as default,
[*] New instructions to make learning about in-depth functions easier
[/list]

[h2]=> Extra polish for Visuals and Audio[/h2]
Shapes are now smoother but keep their sharp form, better SFX in general, and some new effects were added such as a better hit effect to sell the strength of impacts (it changes with Cyberball attributes)

[h3]=> Finally, lots of bug fixes[/h3]

notes.title: New Player Aesthetics, Performance Boost and Big QoL Changes
notes.content:
[h2]Hackshot Version 1.03 Update:[/h2]

[h1]> Major Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] An overhauled gameplay UI, to better show important info for gameplay.
[*] Huge performance boost, the game now runs up to 5 times faster on some complex levels.
[*] Lots of extra polish, new SFX and effects.
[*] Difficulty curve smoothing for late game.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223116/510f06c6d0dc6888c31478ed642a58d7923d6c52.gif[/img]

[h1]> New Content[/h1]
[list]
[*] New Hacker Aesthetic options, unlockable by achieving certain feats.
[*] Additional dialogue branches to make the dialogue more interactive.
[*] New "Ascended" hacks.
[*] New secret win phrases.
[/list]
[h1]> Extra Polish[/h1]
[list]
[*] New sound effects for some late game modifications.
[*] A lot of sound balancing and a few changes to certain sound effects.
[*] Analysis screen now shows stars in addition to their required scores.
[*] Ball score data are conveyed using a chart now instead of text.
[*] New hit direction indicators for dynamic bodies, and now, the indicator has a different shape if the direction is unpredictable.
[*] Cycling mods using key buttons now shows the shortcut keys on screen. Additionally, if the mod is unavailable, an audio que is played and the modwheel will open to show the available mods.
[*] Buttons without shortcuts has dimmed symbols to lower the visual clutter on screen.
[*] New mouse confine options, especially useful for multiscreen setups.
[/list]
[h1]> Changes and Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Dialogue screen now has more intuitive controls for both mouse and keyboard.
[*] Dialogue speed option can now be accessed easily.
[*] Hacker mode display fixes, now, it will be applied correctly when screen display is not set to Window mode.
[*] Key binds screen and File view screen can now be closed using the Esc key.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1757450/Hackshot

notes.title: You are invited for Pre-release Testing. Major content update and a Festival
notes.content:
[h3][b]Pop-up ads can't keep getting away with being an annoying blight on our free internet[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]Become a hacker, demolish scam hackers in a world where TV hacking is real[/b][/h3]

[h1]Pre-Release Testing[/h1]
I have started the pre-release testing for Hackshot, now that it is as polished as ever (barring few things here and there), you are invited to give it a shot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223116/9fb73676bdcc66ae5015d24cfcdd42cbc0a14c94.gif[/img]

With this new update, you can reach much deeper into the system than before. You can now unlock new abilities for all levels, and collect data you weren't able to reach before.

This also opens up the game much more, doubling the content and tripling secrets you can find.

We mainly use Discord to discuss feedback and game updates, but feel free to reach out to me however you wish:
[url=https://discord.gg/UkWe35Krf6][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223116/519f992ad06efcc99ca6f6ed8909126973688017.png[/img][/url]
Twitter: https://twitter.com/RobotDragonInt


[h1]Metroidvania Fusion Festival[/h1]
That's right, Hackshot is taking part in the current running festival, Metroidvania Fusion
[b]https://store.steampowered.com/developer/ravenage/sale/metroidvaniafusion[/b]

[h3]But wait, is Hackshot a Metroidvania?[/h3]
The short answer is no, however, the new update brings the Metroidvania-inspired aspects in the game to the forefront. They can be found within the first 20 mins now !!!

No spoilers, just go explore like a real hacker, the demo is right there ...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1757450/Hackshot/
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223116/13c800a3c8dbcccdcc68398cb01902f5a1eda543.gif[/img]

[h1]QUALITY NEW CONTENT[/h1]
2 players have already finished the game, and reached the end screen, one of those legendary hackers also managed to even 100% the game.

With the help of these players and dozens more along the years, the game has shaped up much better and more expansive than what I originally planned, and around 39% of the cool additions were found or suggested by the players.

[h3]Witnessing the game becoming like this... it is just magical
Thank you all for your help and support[/h3]
